test_purpose: VCST-5705 cross-store wishlist isolation - CAT-079 (catalog listing marker), CAT-080 (PDP marker), WISH-30 (xAPI product.wishlistIds)
notes: ONE customer holding TWO wishlists in TWO DIFFERENT stores, each with a DIFFERENT product. Seeded by scripts/seed-data/wishlists/seed-wishlists.mjs. Store A is {{STORE_ID}}; store B is {{STORE_ID_SECONDARY}} - both are written to aliases.<env>.json at seed time, never committed here, because a store id is per-env. The store-B product is created PHYSICALLY in store Bs own catalog (so it is genuinely available in that store) and additionally LINKED into store As virtual catalog under the ad-hoc Test Fixtures category, because CAT-079 looks for its card on store As /catalog page - that co-visibility is what makes the isolation assertion able to fail. Both storefront urls are store-A-relative (the cases navigate {{FRONT_URL}}@td(...Url)); slug/url are DERIVED by standard-specs.mjs productSlug/storefrontPathForAdHoc and drift-guarded, never hand-maintained. WITHOUT this fixture CAT-079/CAT-080 pass vacuously on a single-store env - which is precisely the defect VCST-5705 was. contact_id / user_id / the two wishlist ids are runtime GUIDs and MUST stay blank here.
